title: Toward an Admissibility Theory of Aharonov--Bohm Arbitrage
abstract: arXiv:2611.19870v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This note develops a provisional admissibility framework for Aharonov-Bohm type arbitrage. Starting from a categorical filtration $F:\mathcal T_{\mathrm{mic}}^{\mathrm{op}}\to \mathsf{Prob}$ and its distortion on microscopic histories, we ask when a favorable closed microscopic loop can be realized as an executable relative ordinal arbitrage over an open macro-time interval. The history endofunctor $\mathsf{Hist}$ retains the staged decomposition of economic activities, while the twisted-arrow category $\operatorname{Tw}(\mathsf{Hist}(\mathcal T_{\mathrm{mic}}))$ represents a microscopic loop as an arrow between distinct histories. An observable clock $\Pi: \mathsf{Econ} \to \mathcal T_{\mathrm{mac}}$ and a microscopic realization functor $J: \mathsf{Hist}(\mathcal T_{\mathrm{mac}}) \to \operatorname{Tw}(\mathsf{Hist}(\mathcal T_{\mathrm{mic}}))$ connect economic histories with their microscopic geometry. translated_title: 迈向阿哈罗诺夫-玻姆套利的容许性理论
translated_abstract: 本简报为阿哈罗诺夫-玻姆型套利提出了一个初步的容许性框架。从一个范畴论过滤 $F:\mathcal T_{\mathrm{mic}}^{\mathrm{op}}\to \mathsf{Prob}$ 及其在微观历史上造成的扭曲出发，我们探讨何时一个有利的封闭微观环路能够在一个开放的宏观时间区间上实现为可执行的相对序数套利。历史自函子 $\mathsf{Hist}$ 保留了经济活动的分阶段分解，而扭转箭头范畴 $\operatorname{Tw}(\mathsf{Hist}(\mathcal T_{\mathrm{mic}}))$ 将一个微观环路表示为不同历史之间的一个箭头。可观测时钟 $\Pi: \mathsf{Econ} \to \mathcal T_{\mathrm{mac}}$ 与微观实现函子 $J: \mathsf{Hist}(\mathcal T_{\mathrm{mac}}) \to \operatorname{Tw}(\mathsf{Hist}(\mathcal T_{\mathrm{mic}}))$ 将经济历史与其微观几何联系起来。可执行性被视为……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文借助历史自函子、扭转箭头范畴、可观测时钟与微观实现函子等范畴论工具，构建了一个初步的容许性框架，用以判定阿哈罗诺夫-玻姆型的有利封闭微观环路何时能够在宏观时间区间上实现为可执行的相对序数套利。
en_tdlr: This note develops a provisional categorical admissibility framework—via a history endofunctor, the twisted-arrow category, an observable clock, and a microscopic realization functor—to determine when a favorable closed microscopic loop can be realized as an executable relative ordinal arbitrage over an open macro-time interval.
